institution: University of Texas at El Paso

app_fee.value: International applicants pay an $80 application fee; U.S. citizens and permanent residents pay $45.
app_fee.quote: International students are assessed an $80 application fee.

fee_waiver.value: No general fee waiver for international graduate applicants was found on the fetched Graduate School pages.

gre_general.value: Each program sets its own GRE rule; the Graduate School says many programs require it.

toefl_min.value: The TOEFL iBT minimum for tests taken on or after January 21, 2026 is 4.5; the older 79 iBT minimum is not recorded.
toefl_min.quote: Tests taken on or after Jan 21, 2026: Minimum TOEFL IBT score of 4.5

ielts_min.value: The IELTS Academic minimum is 6.5 overall band.
ielts_min.quote: Minimum required score is 6.5 overall band
